summary: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a portfolio update as of March 31, 2026. The filing provides selected investment statistics, including 100% first lien senior secured debt, 100% floating rate investments, a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.1x, 38 portfolio companies, and a weighted average EBITDA of $22.1 million. No corporate event, transaction, or special situation is announced. This is a routine portfolio update for a business development company (BDC) and does not involve any action such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. Consequently, no special-situation analysis applies.
